Create Advanced Provider Manager

Source: R/provider_manager.R
create_advanced_provider_manager.Rd

Factory function to create AdvancedProviderManager with failover

Usage

create_advanced_provider_manager(
  providers = list(),
  failover_strategy = "priority",
  circuit_breaker_threshold = 3,
  circuit_breaker_window = 15,
  retry_config = list(max_retries = 2, backoff_factor = 2),
  cache_config = list(enabled = TRUE, ttl_minutes = 60)
)

Arguments

providers

List of data provider objects

failover_strategy

Failover strategy ("priority", "round_robin", "health_based")

circuit_breaker_threshold

Number of failures before circuit breaker trips

circuit_breaker_window

Time window for circuit breaker (minutes)

retry_config

Retry configuration

cache_config

Cache configuration

Value

AdvancedProviderManager object
